privacy: Generalized behavior and source references only. No private raw session text.

cases.input: Two performances of one line survive.
cases.expected: Keep the intended clean take and remove the duplicate.

cases.input: Transcript timing absorbs a long silent envelope.
cases.expected: Use waveform and energy evidence as cut authority.

cases.input: A sentence begins with an unintended repeated first word.
cases.expected: Remove the false start and reverify the join.

cases.input: A new shot appears perceptibly before its speech starts.
cases.expected: Align shot entry and speech within the profile frame tolerance.

cases.input: A leading consonant or digit is missing after a splice.
cases.expected: Restore sample-exact onset protection.

cases.input: The final consonant or syllable is cut.
cases.expected: Restore the complete word ending and verify final audio.

cases.input: A same-filename rebuild reuses old decoded media or metrics.
cases.expected: Invalidate every dependent artifact by content hash.

cases.input: The first three seconds lack a truthful reason to continue.
cases.expected: Repair 0-3 seconds before body polish.

cases.input: The first 30 seconds lack proof, stakes, or route.
cases.expected: Repair the complete viewer-leverage window.

cases.input: A reconstructed UI contains unverified factual elements.
cases.expected: Bind every fact to the Project Fact Brief or omit/block it.

cases.input: A callout or diagram misstates the source.
cases.expected: Correct or remove the label.

cases.input: An arrow points to the wrong product element.
cases.expected: Correct the target and recheck the rendered frame.

cases.input: The important product state is too small on mobile.
cases.expected: Promote proof to a legible layout without losing context.

cases.input: Speaker, caption, or graphic covers proof.
cases.expected: Change layout or safe zones and rerun collision checks.

cases.input: A motion asset freezes before its segment ends.
cases.expected: Extend authored motion through the full semantic segment.

cases.input: A stray shot flashes at a transition boundary.
cases.expected: Remove the flash and recheck adjacent frames.

cases.input: A frame explains itself with paragraphs.
cases.expected: Use a sparse plain label, icon, diagram, or mental model.

cases.input: Talking head or screen footage poorly explains a relationship.
cases.expected: Use HyperFrames to show the relationship spatially.

cases.input: The edit repeats one layout without a proof reason.
cases.expected: Choose a semantically different allowed layout.

cases.input: The CTA reuses a stale animation.
cases.expected: Author a non-repeating CTA treatment that fits the earned transition.

cases.input: A transition decorates without clarifying a state change.
cases.expected: Use a hard cut or document a semantic job.

cases.input: A punch-in adds motion but no meaning.
cases.expected: Remove it or document its communication job.

cases.input: A delivered output cannot prove Descript Studio Sound lineage.
cases.expected: Block until treatment lineage and effect survival pass.

cases.input: A splice or remux loses the treated audio stream.
cases.expected: Restore the proven treated stream and rerun parity.

cases.input: The candidate lacks a suitable upbeat lo-fi bed.
cases.expected: Block until documented license-safe music exists.

cases.input: Music or SFX masks speech.
cases.expected: Repair ducking and mix while preserving purposeful cues.

cases.input: Shorts music is identical or different without purpose.
cases.expected: Use purposeful compatible variation and record the reason.

cases.input: Camera exposure, skin, or white balance changes across shots.
cases.expected: Grade camera footage consistently and preserve screen color.

cases.input: Eddy captions overlap readable source captions.
cases.expected: Suppress Eddy captions for the collision interval.

cases.input: A future word appears before it is spoken.
cases.expected: Snap captions to delivered speech; hide future words.

cases.input: A multi-speaker Short attributes speech to the wrong person.
cases.expected: Use stable accessible color plus concise speaker label.

cases.input: Designed Long captions appear without project opt-in.
cases.expected: Disable them unless the Project Fact Brief opts in.
cases.evidence: brief binding and final frame scan

cases.input: A Short exists only to meet quota.
cases.expected: Drop it; keep only three to five standalone moments.

cases.input: The CTA arrives without a narrative bridge.
cases.expected: Repair the transition so the CTA follows delivered value.

cases.input: The editing agent promotes its own 100 score.
cases.expected: Require an independent no-edit verifier.

cases.input: A final output lacks complete watch and listen coverage.
cases.expected: Reject promotion until all Longs and Shorts are fully reviewed.

cases.input: A 100 score still lists an objective defect.
cases.expected: Reject 100 until objective items are empty.

cases.input: A 100 score references missing or stale evidence.
cases.expected: Reject until every point binds an existing immutable artifact.

cases.input: A project name, URL, price, CTA, logo, runtime, or palette is proposed as generic doctrine.
cases.expected: Keep it in the Project Fact Brief and reject global promotion.
